data.title: Renaissance Macro’s deGraaf: GOP control of Senate and performance of AI appear increasingly linked
data.description: Jeff deGraaf, Renaissance Macro Research chairman and head of technical research, joins 'Squawk on the Street' to discuss the broader markets, what the technicals are telling us, and why he says Republican control of Senate and AI performance seem increasingly linked.
